# [](https://act.mcmorrowformichigan.com/go/685?refcode=&t=1&akid=4999%2E898137%2ETpRoQ8)
**Over**** _$16 million_****has already been spent to boost one of our opponents in this race.**
That’s $16 million coming from corporate PACs, Big Oil, Pharma, AIPAC, and the DC establishment, who’ve decided they want to try to put their thumb on the scale before Michiganders even get to vote.
But here is what they don't want you to see: while corporate and MAGA-funded PACs bail her out with millions in TV ads, our opponent has barely shown up. She has no field program, no grassroots energy, and she isn’t even doing public events to talk to actual voters.
If you’re wondering why so much outside money is being spent this early, you have to ask yourself why. How strong is your candidate if they need to be bailed out instead of earning the win? How is that going to be the strongest candidate to take on well-funded Republican Mike Rogers in November? They want everyone to believe that this race is already decided.
But they don’t decide. You do.
**Here’s what that $16 million doesn’t buy:** → Mallory’s record of delivering for Michiganders. → The fact that Mallory is the candidate best positioned to beat Rogers in November. → The fact that we have the biggest grassroots campaign in this race.
---
Michigan deserves a Senator who answers to Michiganders, not party leaders, not corporate PACs, and not the political establishment.
Mallory doesn’t take a dime from corporate PACs or AIPAC money. But with ballots dropping in days and our end-of-quarter deadline looming, we need your support.

Our top-secret strategy
# [](https://francescahong.com?refcode=em20260616-2922)
Peter,
Fran’s campaign has momentum because people across Wisconsin are ready for something different.
They’re ready for a governor who will take on the billionaires, Big Tech monopolies, insurance companies, corporate landlords, and political insiders who have made life harder for working families.
They’re ready for Fran. And this weekend, we’re going to prove it.
We’re launching a huge [Weekend of Action](https://act.francescahong.com/go/13828?t=1&akid=2922%2E105371%2EKGW0MP) with canvasses across the state — from Madison to Milwaukee, Janesville to Oshkosh, Appleton to Viroqua, Sheboygan to Wisconsin Rapids, and more.
[](https://act.francescahong.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_fh_202606016.U0fQdU&refcode=em20260616-2922&t=2&akid=2922%2E105371%2EKGW0MP)
Fran doesn’t have corporate PAC money. She doesn’t have a network of billionaires waiting to write checks. She has us.
And that’s more powerful — if we show up.
[**Will you sign up for a canvass this weekend and help us reach the voters who will decide this race?**](https://act.francescahong.com/go/13828?t=3&akid=2922%2E105371%2EKGW0MP)
Every conversation matters. Every door matters. Every vote matters.
And if you can’t canvass this weekend, you can still help make this Weekend of Action a success.
[**Chip in $5, $10, or whatever you can to support our volunteers in the field.** ](https://act.francescahong.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_fh_202606016.U0fQdU&refcode=em20260616-2922&t=4&akid=2922%2E105371%2EKGW0MP)
Support like yours helps us print literature, send texts, fuel our organizing program, and make sure volunteers have what they need to reach more voters across Wisconsin.
We know the path to victory: Organize everywhere, talk to everyone, and build a movement big enough to win. This weekend is how we do it.
[**Sign up for a Weekend of Action canvass near you today**](https://act.francescahong.com/go/13828?t=5&akid=2922%2E105371%2EKGW0MP)**—[or chip in $5 to help power the volunteers who are knocking doors for Fran.](https://act.francescahong.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_fh_202606016.U0fQdU&refcode=em20260616-2922&t=6&akid=2922%2E105371%2EKGW0MP)**
Thank you for being part of this movement.
**[Donate $5 ››](https://act.francescahong.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_fh_202606016.U0fQdU&amount=5&refcode=em20260616-2922&t=9&akid=2922%2E105371%2EKGW0MP)**
Let’s go!!
Team Hong

| | | | | | Team Mackenzie,
Just before the Primary Election, Bob Brooks stood up and apologized for supporting law enforcement. That’s right, Brooks’ extreme leftist base made him apologize for once saying positive things about police!
Now Brooks has done something that he actually should apologize for...but probably won’t because he knows it will make his political bosses angry.
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/8pDPLLT9aFm?e=5ccada9200&c2id=772b190546f65300d48df506f9534e27)
| | According to yesterday's story from the _Free Beacon_ ,**Brooks recently took to Facebook and lashed out at volunteer firefighters, referring to those who respond alongside paid firefighters as "scabs" and calling them “s##tbags.”**
---
| [Read The Article Here](https://us.list-manage.com/7bF7mGT8wxm?e=5ccada9200&c2id=772b190546f65300d48df506f9534e27)

[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/dHtKih6BYPb?e=5ccada9200&c2id=772b190546f65300d48df506f9534e27)
| | Volunteer firefighters are the backbone of many communities throughout the Greater Lehigh Valley. They leave their jobs, their families, and their daily lives behind when the call comes in. They don't do it for recognition. They do it because they care about their neighbors and want to serve their communities.That's why Brooks’ comments are so disgusting...especially for someone who uses his own background in firefighting as a centerpiece of his campaign.Whether you are volunteer or paid firefighter; I want to personally thank you for everything you do. You are the men and women who run toward danger when everyone else is running away. You deserve our gratitude and respect, not criticism.**While Bob Brooks is attacking volunteer firefighters, I've spent my time in Congress working to support first responders and deliver real results for our communities.****That includes securing more than $5 million in funding for first responder projects across PA-7, including:****• Alburtis Fire Station Upgrade
• Carbon County Sheriff's Office Equipment and Technology Upgrade
• Bethlehem Police Department Equipment and Technology Upgrade
• Eastern Pennsylvania Regional Communications Upgrades
• Palmer Township Radio Upgrades
• Northampton Borough Police Department Radio Upgrades**I've also supported legislation to strengthen public safety, support law enforcement officers, honor fallen heroes, improve officer wellness, and ensure first responders have the tools and resources they need to do their jobs safely.**The difference is simple: I believe first responders deserve our support and appreciation no matter how they choose to serve - Bob Brooks does not.** To every first responder in the Greater Lehigh Valley, thank you for your service. Our campaign appreciates you, supports you, and will continue fighting for you every day.Sincerely, Ryan Mackenzie
Congressman PA-7

Darren is a third-generation family farmer from rural Southern Illinois who, along with his sons, owns and operates Bailey Family Farm where they grow corn, wheat, and soybeans.

Darren married his high school sweetheart Cindy, and they have lived by the motto faith, family, and farming for more than 39 years. Darren began his chapter of public service on the North Clay Board of Education, where he served on the board for 17, including 12 as President.

In 2018, Darren was called to serve in government and was elected to the Illinois House of Representatives 109th district. There he fought for our freedoms and against tax hikes, reckless spending, and sanctuary state legislation. Darren then served the 55th district in the Illinois State Senate, and with his lifelong background in farming, worked as the lead Republican on the Senate Agriculture Committee.

Darren and Cindy live on their family farm near Louisville, where they enjoy time with their loving family.

A poll just leaked. [It's the first real look at the New Mexico Governor's race since the primary](https://us.list-manage.com/8jUDsrkywha?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e) — and the numbers behind the headline tell a story the press isn't going to tell you.
Deb Haaland leads Gregg Hull. That's the topline. Underneath it, there's a clean hit Hull has on her that nobody is talking about.
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/TeJws0kTlEr?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
| |
🔥 **LEAKED POLL — HAALAND UP 6, BUT THE CRACKS ARE REAL**
The poll went into the field June 9-11 from one of the best firms in the country, and we got a look at every question and every answer in it.
The topline shows Haaland up 6, but the breakdown is where it gets interesting. She's running a 14-point net gender gap with men, and 72% of voters say Haaland is liberal even though only 32% of them describe themselves that way.
The fracking ban is where Hull has his cleanest shot. Even with soft polling language, 44% of voters said it would make them less likely to support her. The real question now is whether Hull is willing to actually throw the punch.

🚨 **$113 MILLION TAX HIKE — THE ONE COUNCIL JUST KILLED IS BACK**
City Council voted 8-1 to reject this in March. Albuquerque Councilor Brook Bassan brought it back anyway — and this time, it's headed to the November ballot.
Half a penny on every dollar. $113 million a year. Funding a project that another councilor — Tammy Fiebelkorn — called a "vanity project."
We pulled the spending data. Albuquerque city spending is up 68% in 10 years.
---
| [Stream No Doubt About It Podcast Now](https://us.list-manage.com/C4PkoRgYxIt?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
---
| |
💰 **NM RANKS 4TH IN TAXES — AND 50TH IN INCOME**
That's not a typo. We rank fourth in the country for total tax burden. We rank dead last for median household income — $25,000 below the U.S. average.
And the city wants to raise the tax again. We do the math.

😂 **ELON MUSK BECOMES FIRST TRILLIONAIRE — CNN IMPLODES**
The SpaceX IPO Friday was the largest in history. $75 billion raised. Musk briefly worth more than $1 trillion on paper. 4,400 SpaceX employees became millionaires overnight.
Bakari Sellers went on CNN and said no one should be "allowed" to have that much money. Scott Jennings's response is one of his best of the year.

name: Senate Majority Update
subject: Re: Georgia
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Chris Pappas for Senate
body:
The path to a Democratic Senate majority runs through Georgia and New Hampshire.
Republicans now have their official Senate nominee in Georgia: **Mike Collins**.
The stage is set for one of the most closely watched races in the country.
But one thing is becoming increasingly clear: Georgia and New Hampshire are the two most important Senate battlegrounds in the country.
**[DONATE TO JON OSSOFF
AND CHRIS PAPPAS ››](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260616_3.VuPY49&amount=5&refcode=em20260616-3&t=1&akid=7222%2E582294%2EFDosVP)**
Here's what's at stake:
– Georgia is one of Republicans' top targets as they work to defeat Jon Ossoff and reclaim a Senate seat Democrats won just a few years ago.
– New Hampshire is one of the GOP's best pickup opportunities, where Chris Pappas is running to keep this critical seat blue.
– Both races are expected to attract tens of millions of dollars in outside spending because the fight for Senate control could come down to just a handful of states.
**National Republicans understand what's on the line in November.**
That's why they're already spending heavily in Georgia and New Hampshire – with plans to pour millions more into each state by Election Day. They know that winning either race would bring them one step closer to controlling the Senate.
**[Split a donation between
Jon Ossoff and Chris Pappas ›› ](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260616_3.VuPY49&amount=5&refcode=em20260616-3&t=2&akid=7222%2E582294%2EFDosVP)**
**The path to a Democratic Senate majority runs through Georgia and New Hampshire.**
If we're going to protect these seats, it'll take grassroots supporters stepping up early to help our campaigns build the resources needed to compete.
**[Split $5 – or whatever you can afford today – between Jon Ossoff and Chris Pappas to help defend two of the most important Senate seats in the country.](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260616_3.VuPY49&refcode=em20260616-3&t=3&akid=7222%2E582294%2EFDosVP)**

Team Pappas

body:
We can replace a corporate-backed, Do-Nothing Democrat with a real progressive fighter for working people.
#
Peter,
The Colorado Democratic primary is only two weeks away, **which means we have just 14 days left to elect Justice Democrat Melat Kiros in CO-01!**
She’s taking on 15-term incumbent Rep. Diana DeGette, a longtime Washington establishment politician backed by corporate-aligned interests like Big Pharma and AIPAC.
Melat’s running because she knows we can’t solve our biggest problems with politicians who answer to the same corporations and billionaires keeping prices high, fueling climate crises, and profiting from endless wars and genocide.
**Instead, she’s fighting for Medicare for All, housing as a human right, universal childcare, ending forever wars, and a government that actually puts working people over profits.**
In a recent debate, she called out her opponent without hesitation: when DeGette claimed she didn’t know why Congress hasn’t passed Medicare for All, Melat pointed to the real obstacle — _politicians like DeGette who continue to cash checks from Big Pharma while families struggle to afford care._
_That’s why this race matters, Peter._
Transforming the Democratic Party doesn’t happen by asking the same do-nothing, entrenched politicians to do better. It happens by taking them on, voting them out, and replacing them with leaders who are ready to fight for working families.
**Melat is running to do exactly that — and we need your help to make sure we can get her across the finish line in two weeks.**
Like every Justice Democrat, Melat refuses corporate PAC money and is running a grassroots campaign completely fueled by people power.
**[With just 14 days left, we need the resources to reach every voter and turn our momentum into victory. Can you rush $10 or whatever you can to Justice Democrats and Melat Kiros before the June 30th primary?](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260616-mk.a8ecro&refcode=em20260616-37916&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=10&t=2&akid=37916%2E1203867%2EybvgMD)**

In solidarity,
Justice Democrats

body:

| | | | | | Hi Peter,
On Sunday, I laid out my vision for how I believe the Wisconsin State Treasurer can be a force for good. Watch my speech below!
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/D8Z__y3UtkY?e=f59034ca3e&c2id=997c4beee76ce03997da9db4fe50bd09)
|
---
| |
_**Wisconsin’s problem is not that we are too divided. It’s that our systems are not built for us.** They are built for consultants and special interests who use confusion and division to get their way._
_That’s why I have a plan for the State Treasurer’s office to use**Public Power for the Public Good.**__**I will bring Government Transparency into the 21st-Century.** I have a degree in economics and a Master's in Public Affairs _– _but when I got elected to the school board,**I** found our budgets confusing! As State Treasurer, I will make publicly available information **publicly understandable** with a visual, public budget dashboard showing exactly how money flows from our State into your community.__**I will continue to defend Public Education.** I have the experience to protect our**** $1.6 billion Common School Trust Fund from political interference so it always delivers stable funding for our classrooms.__**And** **I’ll** **work across the state** , hand in hand with local organizers, to get basic transparency onto every property tax bill in Wisconsin. **You** deserve to see exactly how much of your hard-earned money is being stripped away from public schools and funneled into an unaccountable, private voucher system!__**Because if you don’t know, you deserve to know, Wisconsin!**_
---
|
---
| |
I believe every single office needs to be a lever of progress in this time of crisis – not just the Governor and our legislators, but the State Treasurer and every constitutional office. We have **seven weeks** until the primary election on August 11th, and at the end of this month, we have our largest fundraising deadline yet.
[June 30th will be a crucial deadline for our campaign, determining how many resources we have for the final stretch, and we need your help. If you’re able, please donate $15, $25 (or if you’re able!) more to help power us through this final stretch.](https://us.list-manage.com/DackF3KzP69?e=f59034ca3e&c2id=997c4beee76ce03997da9db4fe50bd09)
We’d love it if you follow along with the campaign on socials too - [Facebook](https://us.list-manage.com/_jXnl3o4U_a?e=f59034ca3e&c2id=997c4beee76ce03997da9db4fe50bd09), [Instagram](https://us.list-manage.com/19Go6pY7XUe?e=f59034ca3e&c2id=997c4beee76ce03997da9db4fe50bd09), [TikTok](https://us.list-manage.com/azbBHm3UebD?e=f59034ca3e&c2id=997c4beee76ce03997da9db4fe50bd09).
Thank you for being with us in this fight to use _**Public Power for the Public Good**_ ,Dylan

Watch my speech below! | | | Wisconsin’s problem is not that we are too divided. It’s that our systems are not built for us. That’s why I have a plan for the State Treasurer’s office to usePublic Power for the Public Good.I will bring Government Transparency into the 21st-Century. I have a degree in economics and a Master's in Public Affairs – but when I got elected to the school board,I found our budgets confusing! As State Treasurer, I will make publicly available information publicly understandable with a visual, public budget dashboard showing exactly how money flows from our State into your community.I will continue to defend Public Education. I have the experience to protect our** $1.6 billion Common School Trust Fund from political interference so it always delivers stable funding for our classrooms.And I’ll work across the state , hand in hand with local organizers, to get basic transparency onto every property tax bill in Wisconsin. name: Sara Jacobs
subject: Trump doesn’t understand — or he just doesn’t care
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Sara Jacobs for Congress
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em?amount=25 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em?amount=25]
Hi friend,
There is a deadly Ebola outbreak spreading in the Democratic Republic of the Congo right now, and the United States — the country that once led the global response to exactly this kind of crisis — can't do much about it.
Why? Because Donald Trump (with the help of Elon Musk’s DOGE) dismantled every tool we had built to respond exactly to this kind of crisis.
Trump slashed funding to WHO, shut down USAID entirely, and made cuts to the CDC. Oh — and right now, the Trump administration is in the process of reducing the health aid it gives to the DRC and Uganda, the two countries being hit hardest by this Ebola epidemic.
Every single one of these moves has weakened the global health systems that help contain outbreaks like this one, and now, aid workers on the ground have confirmed that our funding cuts have hindered their ability to respond quickly and effectively.
And let's be clear about what else this administration has done to our foreign assistance: they ordered $10 million in contraceptives — already purchased with taxpayer dollars — to be destroyed. They incinerated 500 tons of emergency food, enough to feed 27,000 starving children for a month, even after the U.N. offered to distribute it before it expired.
And now, more people are unnecessarily suffering and dying of Ebola in Africa, because of our government’s dangerous cuts.
You can’t say you care about Americans’ safety, and then gut the very infrastructure that keeps dangerous diseases from reaching our shores in the first place. Ebola doesn't stop at borders, and neither do the consequences of this administration's recklessness.
The bottom line is that foreign assistance isn't charity. It’s about making the world a safer, healthier, more just place, and by containing crises before they become our crises, we protect Americans, too.
Trump doesn't seem to understand that — or maybe he just doesn't care. Either way, the threat of this outbreak is just one more reason we need to flip the House in November.
I’m up for re-election this year, and I could really use your help to make sure we hold my seat, retake the majority in Congress, and fight back against Trump’s reckless cuts that are endangering us all. Will you chip in today to power this work? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em?amount=25]

Hi, it's Quentin James, Founder and President of The Collective PAC and author of the forthcoming book "_Our Path Forward: Black Men Redefining American Democracy. "_
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/dc83cc5a-53e1-43bc-af96-e5cc7a4a4e46?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Today was supposed to be the day.
Thanks for reading! Subscribe for free to receive new posts and support my work.
[Subscribed](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9jb2xsZWN0aXZlcGFjLnN1YnN0YWNrLmNvbS9hY2NvdW50IiwicCI6MjAyMzczODI2LCJzIjo2ODIwNjM3LCJmIjp0cnVlLCJ1Ijo5MDUwMTE5MiwiaWF0IjoxNzgxNjYyNzk3LCJleHAiOjIwOTcyMzg3OTcsImlzcyI6InB1Yi0wIiwic3ViIjoibGluay1yZWRpcmVjdCJ9.boQS9KY7n42tyZf4lXRWHLWcKWtCzadkO6mRyhuzeW8?)
I picked this date months ago and told you _Our Path Forward_ would be in your hands by now. I announced it in April, on my birthday, with everything mapped out. The book isn't coming today, and I wanted you to hear that from me before you heard it anywhere else.
The hardest part first. In April, I lost my friend Justin Fairfax. Justin, the former lieutenant governor of Virginia, took the life of his wife, Cerina, and then his own. Cerina was a mother, business owner and phenomenal woman. The two children they leave behind will grow up without either of them. I have been grieving her, and grieving him, and trying to make peace with something I may never understand.
Justin is in this book. Over the years, we spent so much time together, talking about ambition and loss and what this country does to Black men who get close to power. We last spoke just two a few weeks before the tragedy took place. Those pages were already written. After April, I couldn't let them stand the way they were. It wouldn't have been honest, and it wouldn't have been right. So I went back in with my editor, section by section, to center the truth as it stands now. That work matters more to me than any date on a calendar.
And the truth is I have not been whole while doing it.
This is Men's Mental Health Month, and I didn't plan for it to land on me the way it has. The grief hasn't come one loss at a time. It stacks up and it doesn't wait its turn. I have been carrying Cerina and Justin. I have been carrying my friend Wesley Brown, who I knew for years, who died of cancer a few weeks ago back home in South Carolina. I have been carrying the memory of two more brothers I lost, Emanuel Perry and Peter Brown, men I still reach for out of habit before I remember they're gone.
All of that, and the work never stopped. The book. The Collective PAC. A new printing franchise. The phone that keeps ringing because the stakes keep climbing. Since April, the Supreme Court gutted Section 2 of the Voting Rights Act in _Louisiana v. Callais_ , the strongest tool we had against racial gerrymandering, and there was no time to grieve before getting back to it. That has been the shape of this season. Leading with everything I've got, while running on a tank closer to empty than I let most people see.
Here is what I keep coming back to. The argument of this book never changed. Black men are solutions, not problems. What these months taught me is something I should have said louder from the beginning. The healing has to come with the power. A man can't carry this much if he's quietly breaking underneath it, and too many of us are breaking in private while the world only sees the title and the suit. That isn't a soft addition to the work. It's the condition for doing the work at all.
So here is where things stand. The manuscript is finished. The book is real, and it's close. We're setting a new date, and I'll share it the moment it's set. The website will catch up to all of this soon. [Pre-orders are open,](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/6d210dff-139b-4833-b4bf-15d86a98fad5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and if you've already ordered, thank you for holding the line with me while I get this right.
I built The Collective PAC with my wife, Stefanie, on one belief. Black political power is real, and it's ours to build. More than 500 candidates we've helped send into office are the proof, and the receipts are in the record. This book is the next piece of that. It's coming. I just needed it to be whole before it was on time, the same way I'm learning to be whole myself.
Thank you for being here. I'll talk to you again soon, with a date and with more of this story.
Quentin
* * *

Hi Peter,

Fourteen years ago, the Obama Administration created DACA and gave hundreds of thousands of young people a chance to live, work, study, and contribute in the only country many of them have ever known. Today, that promise is under attack again.
Across the country, DACA recipients are waiting months for renewals that used to be routine. That means people who follow the rules and do everything asked of them are being left without answers. For many, a delay can mean losing a job or the stability their families depend on.
In San Diego, this is not abstract. Our community has thousands of DACA recipients in our region.
Trump and Republicans in Congress are pouring billions more in funding into ICE and CBP while families in San Diego and across the country live in fear of aggressive enforcement, family separation, and a system with too little accountability.
Scott believes immigration policy should be comprehensive, fair, practical, and humane. That means protecting Dreamers, fixing broken processing systems, and treating people with dignity.
**Add your name to stand with Scott and send a message in fighting for an immigration system that reflects our values.**

---
Immigration should not be used to demonize people who work hard and follow the rules. It should be about fairness, accountability, and a real pathway to the American dream.
It’s crucial we prove Scott and his Democratic colleagues have the support to stand up to Trump and the Republicans pushing their extremist agenda on immigration.
Thank you for your support -
Jasmine, Team Peters

name: Stacy Garrity
subject: Why this race matters
body:
Pennsylvania is at a crossroads, and the decisions we make now will shape our future.

| | | | | [|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/K8ZouTCERdS?e=63ab67bb25&c2id=8377c90e3583a614e646f5b9492ea9fd&i=dc10a23dc6)
| | | | | | Peter,

I want to take a moment to talk with you directly about why this race matters so much.
Pennsylvania is the Keystone State. When we're strong, our communities thrive, businesses grow, families succeed, and our children have opportunities right here at home.
Unfortunately, that's not the direction we're headed.
Too many families are struggling to keep up with rising costs. Too many businesses are looking elsewhere to expand. Too many young people are leaving Pennsylvania because they don't see a future here.
We should be leading the nation.
Instead, we've watched our economic competitiveness decline while Harrisburg politicians focus on headlines and political ambitions rather than delivering real results for the people they serve.
I believe Pennsylvania deserves better.
We should be unleashing our energy potential, creating family-sustaining jobs, making our communities safer, improving educational opportunities, and ensuring state government works for taxpayers instead of special interests.
That's what this campaign is about.
This election isn't simply about choosing a Governor.
It's about choosing the direction of our Commonwealth for years to come.
Will we continue down the same path, or will we choose stronger leadership, greater opportunity, and a government that puts Pennsylvania families first?
I know where I stand.
And I'm grateful that you're standing with me.
Thank you for being part of this campaign and helping us build a brighter future for the Commonwealth we love.
---

name: TPUSA Faith
subject: Is the fight still worth it?
body:
A weary California pastor found his answer last month.
| [ ](https://d1K2-504.na1.hubspotlinks.com/Ctc/DN+113/d1K2-504/VVR-SM772Tm7W1JNfKD3YM9K-W178YCN5QpByTN99fz9s3qn9qW7Y8-PT6lZ3lfW5KsGCg7tfZjzV1VHHr5YSpljN7T1V81lKr00W3qGtQH2ZbW3yV_MKnk967tN7W83Pgg08b3N9HW4S4Vqk8DxKRdW7LNsKc7dfnTCW30_35m7LS8-pW1mW1Vg1XX0sLW5n09--8cG0GsN8-N4CL4ZDXXW5GW2481JDyP0W5hlqyf6RdQ2WW3cFjVp2lBl3WW4nc01X7Pz8VfW6NYDfv86k8MKV_Ztt28l1s9hN73sBJQpbJLPW4_8fBv3nsJ5fW88JY-X4cVmm6W2v5sTD66S_hQN8gmlYg1Q1GqV7k5L3356mtnW1cD7548gSrmfN7P7bdcmkcWtf4fB4hg04)
---
Dear Peter,
---
A senior pastor in California said something last month that we haven't been able to shake. He told our regional manager, Samantha Birtola, that he had grown weary. Ministry in California had worn him down, and he'd quietly started wondering whether the fight was still worth it. Then his church hosted our Christ and Culture night. By the end of the evening, he said he remembered why this work is worth fighting for... and that the Lord had not left him to fight it alone.
---
---
That's what May looked like for TPUSA Faith. We're grateful to Ross Johnston and the speakers who spent that evening pouring into the believers in that room. And there was more.

**Good morning!** On this day in 1965, the Texas Panhandle Heritage Foundation presented the first showing of [_Thundering Sounds of the West_](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0D2OgzAQxfHTmA40dhw-Chfb0GXbLdGAx2DF2MjMxsntV8kVtn7S70n_n9t0Qx98XL9xJ8NPl6ZI5QzETHninA6_YDg55b0gL1vAsuOdJgWqraGtZTdZ9OE16cqaGewgKzKy62U7aKWh2owj0OhAo9K97GBepFUww3UAcr3TUHnzxqCVnZRwufaNHWboSNOM7op974QGsp5TbngjpieeLrzSg3KzpL0KZmM-TnH5EmoUaiylNHxumGLwkZqUV6HGDaOdU7oLNVLk7OkUavxQ9YHxvQaqN8qecaXapd9okX2KVTb2KD4Ef7ad0LDu6MPnlv8X62HUXwAAAP__nESBrw), a sound-and-light show that ran until September 6 and attracted 36,000 visitors. Not your speed? Another Six Flags option is [the Oil Derrick](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0DFuwyAUgOHT4C0WYGzjgaGLpQ7p2tF6wCNGxSGCl5Dcvkqv0PmXvuH_Pm9niCleL19woKFnyNsVW01IhGWjkm_RQaqUy9GA3J6gHfCDm-RyOvHpJObNQ0yvTXXeWO4X0aERsxbToqTi3W64VR59wAHkiBaWAfQUFnRCAziloYvmjfFJzELwYdS9XyyfUaGFMILWgSmOPlIuPe1I-IQa0is_sPQuH10yO9GtsuGDyZXJtbXWv_Kd7hbfncm17rlQZXJdXDzV8_gZBtcV428tphTrNDPFLwfE9OfR_y48jPwNAAD__2ZGcw0), which is basically an elevator to the top of a tower built in 1969. Trump has now weaponized the FBI to interfere in the upcoming midterm elections.
The Ohio Organizing Collaborative is one of, if not, the largest progressive organization that registers voters in the state. They concentrate their efforts in Ohio's metropolitan areas like Columbus, Cincinnati, and Cleveland--the bluest parts of the state.
As Democrat Sherrod Brown continues to lead in the polls for Ohio's upcoming U.S. Senate election, a win that would all but ensure the chamber flips, the Trump admin is looking to put its thumbs on the scales by any means possible.
In March, it was revealed that Ohio's MAGA Secretary of State handed the state's entire voter registration list to Trump's Justice Department. That list includes 8 million people. Now the federal government has the name, address, date of birth, driver's license and partial Social Security numbers of every single one of those voters:

Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw
Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18] | Jacob Davis's Market Brief (ads) | | • | Behind the Markets ---|--- | • | Weiss Ratings Plus ---|--- | • | Salem Media Group ---|--- | | | Market Commentary Disclaimer We encourage all readers to consult a qualified financial professional — such as a registered investment adviser or licensed broker — before making any investment decision. | Dear Peter,
Young people are leaving Massachusetts.
Families can't afford homes.
Employers can't find workers.
The affordability crisis is driving hardworking people out of our state.
🚨 RECORD SCRATCH 🚨
You probably thought I was saying that.
I wasn't. Kim Driscoll was.
"Our young adults are telling us what we're doing currently doesn't work for them." "Too many families are struggling to find homes they can afford." "Employers are struggling to attract and retain workers." "The largest population that is leaving Massachusetts right now is 26 to 35 year olds."
So let me ask a simple question: If Kim Driscoll knows exactly what the problems are, why hasn't she done anything to solve them?
Since day one, Kim Driscoll has been part of the Healey administration that helped create this affordability crisis.
Young people are leaving. Housing costs keep climbing. Families are getting squeezed.
And Governor Healey continues to duck, hide, and avoid accountability.
ENOUGH IS ENOUGH.
Massachusetts doesn't have an awareness problem.
It has a leadership problem.
If we're going to solve the affordability crisis and make Massachusetts more affordable, it's going to take a new governor.
[Will you chip in $50, $100, or whatever you can today to help fund the grassroots operation that will knock doors, meet voters face-to-face, and deliver the change Massachusetts needs?](https://qgzxgy5ab.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001eos6BtUAm3KyDVfdosKPdpZmmP9dCKsNLnoloxpjXr9GoM5q9Z2TNYQpDN9pM6iCyV17xvUXAx0T96NABefYbrUlfj1eWVUCAXpAsUSbkGLEvziVKCdpR47bPxmludaUVC32IzKPdEva49xN2x3jhPMXt11YgFB-1Xg74_tRHXahI_c568ZtXuLJz901sTNiS7Cyc3j8w_o=&c=FwL8fAZMu0S3pFM_tlFWyiq4XHbgp56ZLHkDM2Vw6rIrPm6y2fVXRA==&ch=D1AZx2F3ammPFkzpN1Ffg8XH4jumERiplg4-But2OcbGL5T0VyA7Ew==)

| | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The notable part: the United States signed on to the statement — a level of alignment with Europe that hasn't always come easy for this White House.The SituationWashington is still holding the fine print close. The full terms of the deal — which ends the fighting and reopens the strategic waterway that carries roughly a fifth of the world's oil — are expected to be **formally signed Friday at a resort in Switzerland**. Trump has already said he authorized lifting the U.S. naval blockade of Iranian ports as part of the arrangement.
* The G7 declaration backed **unrestricted transit through the Strait of Hormuz** and a France/UK-led effort to restart maritime traffic safely
* Leaders pledged to **tighten sanctions on Russia's oil and gas sector** , calling the Iran breakthrough the right moment to squeeze Moscow's war economy
* The statement reaffirmed support for Ukraine, including more air-defense systems and interceptors
* Iran accused Israel of violating the terms with strikes in southern Lebanon and threatened a "harsh response" — and Trump was critical of the ally too

The PerspectiveFor months the critics said Trump's pressure campaign would isolate America and spike prices forever. Instead, the same G7 governments that lectured this administration are now signing their names under his deal — and turning that leverage straight onto Putin. Strength got results where endless "diplomacy" never did. The signing in Switzerland will tell us how durable it is, but the direction is unmistakable.[Read the full story at NBC News](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/v1/c/gtproqWC2%2FFN8LstV0Btp1AGWQ8i5S7%2Fv8bTwJZXfj1I7E%2Foj3b8z%2BLQTEs0%0A3fLkxmEaIaLkOQZ4ilNTHIvBOisIA2T%2B%2FG9Xn9pfJQ25skdGTB6h1%2BuGYZ3U%0A%2FF8orP8y%2BlHxvYfd3NBoRkWPYxkBGWvQfKX9M68UGA1Lt7zs%2Bg00cO%2B8fux1%0AI6MdMH6PXetL2sJwDpobElNlB2EJI9ROmA%3D%3D%0A/4097aca0048c4cf2)The EconomyOIL TUMBLES TO A THREE-MONTH LOW AS THE DEAL TAKES HOLDWhat HappenedEnergy markets are already pricing in peace. U.S. crude closed down **4.8% to $80.75 a barrel** and international Brent fell **4.7% to $83.17** — the lowest settlements for both since the first week of March, just after the war began. Wholesale gasoline dropped more than 2.5% and heating oil, a jet-fuel proxy, fell over 3.5%.The SituationThis is the move the administration promised. Trump said for months that prices would "drop like a rock" once Iran came to the table and the strait reopened — and crude is now roughly two-thirds of the way back to where it started the year.
* Analysts caution that physically reopening Hormuz means moving **thousands of tankers** and convincing insurers and crews it's safe
* Brent contracts for delivery through early 2027 held near $80, a sign traders expect supply to normalize gradually, not overnight
* Crude is still up about **40% since January** — proof of how much the war cost American drivers in the first place

Mike Collins won the Republican Senate runoff in Georgia on Tuesday night, defeating former University of Tennessee football coach Derek Dooley. Collins now takes on **Democratic Sen. Jon Ossoff** in November in what's shaping up as one of the most competitive — and most expensive — races on the 2026 map.The SituationTrump endorsed Collins over the weekend, days before the vote. Dooley had the backing of Gov. Brian Kemp, who argued the party needed an "outsider" to beat Ossoff. Collins — a trucking-company owner and self-described "MAGA warrior" — led the May 19 primary and closed it out in the runoff.
* Ossoff is the **only Democratic senator running for reelection in a state Trump carried in 2024** , making Georgia a must-hold for Democrats
* Democrats need a net gain of four seats to flip the Senate; Republicans see Georgia as a top pickup
* Collins sponsored the **Laken Riley Act** and plans to make immigration a central contrast with Ossoff
* In a twist, Kemp's pick for the open governor's race also lost — a rough night for the establishment lane

The PerspectiveA late Trump endorsement once again proved decisive, and Georgia primary voters chose the fighter over the coach the establishment sent in. Ossoff will have a national fundraising machine and a friendly press behind him. Republicans just nominated the candidate most willing to take the swing straight at him.[Read the full story at CBS News](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/v1/c/cnkn2nPQfURiD4EcKzQNj3O4kpWW0C0wbHjt9brrFG307KspA5JH8GANAbsI%0AhPfGAq4LbT0YdYIFBeuIFA%2FXzmI09YcTV2vDbCEwEzoerysvGfkHsHJeiv63%0AIVUlKyGr7qrwSzFps2Cb%2FF9CrD16z6RC%2FjDihZV8BXlzYNQBuROeQdQ%2BgiVs%0A51ZVk0ZTMBi10ccM%2BG6rmuaOJ57rF4IcHQ%3D%3D%0A/d128f0ea6ca44f8a)Law & OrderDOJ CHARGES 15 IN MINNESOTA ANTI-ICE CONSPIRACY CASEWhat's HappeningThe Justice and Homeland Security departments announced Tuesday that **15 protesters in Minnesota** face charges including conspiracy to impede or injure federal officers, assault on a federal officer, and destruction of government property. Represent your zip code at the GOP’s Midterm Convention...

| **__A Secure Briefing from the Desk of Jim Jordan__**
---
Friend,
---
I can’t lie to you, I’m deeply worried for our country...
---
**In special election after special election, Obama-funded Democrats have CRUSHED Republicans in voter turnout – and with just over 5 months to go until Election Day, Democrats are _still_ LEADING in all the generic ballot polls! **
---
But we still have time to turn the tide back in our favor.
---
I think in many ways this election is really two sentences: **_They're _crazy_. We're _not_._**
---
_Congressional Democrats have an abysmally low 18% approval rating because they want to open our borders, defund the police, indoctrinate our children, censor our free speech, and shred our constitutional rights._
---
However, that means NOTHING if we can’t motivate Republican voters to show up and cast a ballot when we need them most!
---
**Look – if we’re going to defy history and win the midterm elections, Republicans can’t just say we’re going to stop the Radical Left and call it a day.**
---
Instead, we have to give voters a reason to cast a ballot **_for_** the GOP, not merely **_against_** the Democrats!
---
What we need to do is contrast the Left’s insanity with our own common-sense platform that appeals to the vast majority of Americans, just like President Trump did during his historic victory in 2024.
---
That’s why the President announced that the GOP will be holding an unprecedented midterm convention!
---

[](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---

With Republicans trailing in the polls, everything now rests on this historic, first-ever midterm convention. This is our best – _and likely, our final_ – chance to showcase our winning platform and make our case to the American people in front of the entire nation.
---
**But our winning platform can’t be written in Congress, the West Wing, or on Air Force One. Nope! It can ONLY be written directly by salt of the earth grassroots _voters_ like **_YOU._****
---
Out of thousands of eligible voter records, I’ve chosen YOU to represent your zip code as an official **Virtual Grassroots Delegate** for our Midterm Convention based on your exemplary track record of supporting both President Trump and the Republican Party.
---
_I hope you won’t let me down, Friend._
---
[**Please complete the GOP’s Midterm Convention Platform Survey to represent your zip code as a “Virtual Grassroots Delegate” – and your input will be used to help write our Party’s winning platform at our FIRST-EVER Midterm Convention.**](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---

[COMPLETE THE SURVEY ](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---

Thank you,
---
[](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
Jim Jordan
---

Hello.
My name is Miguel Cardona. I served as the U.S. Secretary of Education under President Joe Biden. Before that, I worked as a fourth-grade teacher and one of the youngest principals in our nation.
Today, I’m reaching out to ask you to make a donation to GIFFORDS PAC ahead of their FEC fundraising deadline. GIFFORDS has been in the fight to end the gun violence epidemic from the beginning, and I am proud to support them ahead of the upcoming elections.
Let me elaborate.
Gun violence is the leading cause of death among our children and teens. More than cancer, more than car crashes.
That should concern every single person reading this. Each of those deaths is a child who will never grow up to live out their dreams. Families who will have an empty spot at their dinner table forever. We cannot become numb to the fact that our children are being murdered...especially when we have the tools to stop it.
Our elected leaders have the power and responsibility to end this nightmare, but far too many are in the pocket of the gun lobby.**The NRA is spending millions of dollars to elect extremist candidates and prevent common-sense solutions from moving forward.**
We cannot accept this as our reality.
The November midterms are less than 150 days away, and GIFFORDS PAC is on the front lines to win back a gun sense majority. They are working to elect leaders who have the courage to stop the NRA’s influence in our politics and deliver real results, but they cannot do it alone.

Your donation will help us counter the NRA’s millions in spending, and it adds up when everybody is chipping-in what they can.**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giff-em-q22026.A9rDp6&refcode=em260616-1-b&t=2&akid=11560%2E3935704%2EX3sRhR)

# _She’s in the lead._
---
| |
### _This race is about more than just a seat._
---
| | | | | | | | | | | | Washington has taught politicians to spend more time dialing for dollars than talking to voters.**Elizabeth Dempsey Beggs is rejecting that entirely.**
Instead of chasing donors behind closed doors, she's running every mile of Virginia's First District. Instead of treating voters as data points, she's meeting them face-to-face. Instead of assuming she knows what people need, she's asking.
It's a simple idea, but in modern politics it's become surprisingly rare: if you want to represent a community, you should spend time in it; and more so, push yourself to your limits for it. Every mile is a reminder that democracy isn't built in committee rooms or fundraising receptions. It's built in conversations between neighbors. This run demonstrates the resolve, grit and determination of your future representative, and it gives constituents the opportunity to better get to know who is fighting for them.
If you’re sick of a sedentary Congress that won’t lift a finger to help with your issues, then help push us through this race. **Sponsor a mile** of face-to-face interaction between Virginians and one relentless fighter with a donation of _$20_.

# **JUDGE ORDERS FLEMING TO TAKE DOWN FALSE ATTACK AD**
_Temporary restraining order marks latest legal blow to Fleming’s campaign of false attacks_
**BATON ROUGE, LA** — A Louisiana District Court judge has issued a temporary restraining order against John Fleming’s campaign, ordering **Fleming for Louisiana, Inc.** to stop creating, funding, and disseminating a false attack advertisement against Congresswoman Julia Letlow.
In the order, the court found “good cause” that a false statement about a candidate for election had been made and immediately enjoined Fleming’s campaign from continuing to run the advertisement or any substantially similar ad. The order also requires Fleming’s campaign to instruct broadcasters airing the ad to remove it from their programming.
This marks the**third time** Fleming’s campaign has been ordered by a judge to stop running false advertising about Julia Letlow.
_“John Fleming has been caught lying again,”_**said Congresswoman Julia Letlow.**_“A Louisiana judge has now ordered his campaign to take down another false attack ad because John Fleming cannot tell the truth. He disparaged my family. He lied about his own record. He lied about his job title with President Trump. And now he has been ordered by a court to stop spreading false claims about me.”_

He said that when we're in it together, we can accomplish a great deal. That was just as true 60 years ago as it is true today. There is only one way out of this difficult moment where Republicans control the White House, the Senate and the House of Representatives ... and that is together. Chris Pappas needs you. Our democracy needs you. Future generations need you. And it's why I am asking: Thank you for your support during the Proposition 50 fight in California, and thank you for supporting Chris today. Gavin Newsom New Hampshire is poised to be one of the closest Senate races in the country. Will you chip in today to help Chris stop the Republicans from flipping the Granite State red and expanding their Senate majority?

# The Honest Version of a Small Ask
### Substack is doing sponsorships now. Here's how it actually works--including the part other newsletters won't tell you.
| | | [Blue Amp Media](https://substack.com/@blueamp)
---
| Jun 17
---
| [](https://substack.com/@blueamp)
---
Substack is rolling out sponsorships, and I'm going to tell you how it actually works--including the parts other newsletters won't.
Here's the deal. Substack now matches publications like ours with brands. The way we get matched to sponsors you'd actually want--instead of whatever junk lands in your inbox everywhere else--is if Substack knows a little about who reads Blue Amp Media. That's what this short survey is for.
A few things, straight:
* It isn't elegant. Seven quick questions that we're not allowed to change, and half of Substack is sending the exact same survey this week because they sprang it on all of us at the same time. I know. 🙄
* The data belongs to Substack, not to us. They hold it, they own it, and it powers their matching. We don't see your individual answers--we just get a clearer picture of the audience as a whole.

We've already told them who we'll never take money from. **No MAGA cash, no crypto grifters, no Temu-grade junk.** This just helps them find the sponsors worth saying yes to.
[Start Survey](https://substack.com/redirect/d426be44-e249-4f1c-8c41-b27e39f9067c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
If you've got two minutes, filling it out genuinely helps us land the kind of partnerships that keep this thing independent--and keep what you see relevant instead of random.
And if you'd rather not hand Substack your data? No harm, no worries. We totally get it, and we're good either way. 💙
Thanks for being here. It matters more than you know.
_**-- Cliff**_

Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
DemocracyDocket: SAVE America Act would crash voter registration drives [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?refcode=061726_1&amount=36]
Team -- the SAVE America Act would eviscerate our fundamental right to vote. So, of course, Donald Trump is pushing for this zombie legislation again, months after we thought it was dead.
The MAGA movement knows that this bill -- from the original SAVE Act to all the various clones -- is the easiest way to deny our right to vote and preserve their power. That's why Trump called for its passage again this week , saying it needed to be passed before he fully nominates a new Director of National Intelligence.
Voter registration is the quickest response to voter suppression legislation. Opponents of voting rights have seen how pro-democracy groups like ours have mobilized new voters in the face of suppression, so they're now targeting the work of pro-voting groups to stop our ability to register new voters .
We're kicking our efforts to register voters ahead of the midterms into high gear. The math is simple:
➜ It costs us around $3 to register a new voter
➜ That means for every $30,000 we raise, we could register 10,000 new voters
➜ Polls show a major shift going on, and this work can truly impact 2026's elections
Not to mention that the more people who vote, the more our government looks like us and not the privileged powerful .
Will you chip in $36 or more today to help register 12 new voters? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?refcode=061726_1&amount=36]
GIVE $36 RIGHT NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?express_lane=true&refcode=061726_1&amount=36]
Don't get the importance of voter registration? Listen to Michelle Obama: She's compared modern voter suppression tactics to “ poll taxes, literacy tests, and laws designed to strip away [our] power, ” and said that “ we must give Congress no choice but to act decisively to protect the right to vote and make the ballot box more accessible for everyone. ” We do that by electing as many pro-voting candidates to Congress as possible.
There's so much on the line in these midterms , with just months to go before Election Day. Registering more new voters this year could make the difference between opponents of voting rights staying in charge to codify voter suppression for the next decade or having the votes we need to pass sweeping new voting rights laws.
Team: Your $36 goes directly to forging a more inclusive democracy by registering 12 new voters and making sure every single vote counts. Chip in today to help our coalition reach our goal and make a real difference to protect our voting rights >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?refcode=061726_1&amount=36]
