name: Working Families Party
subject: Elon Musk just became a trillionaire
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Working Families Party PAC (77 Sands St
body:
| | | Peter, **Elon Musk just became the world's first trillionaire.** After SpaceX's stock market debut last week, Musk now controls more wealth than any individual in human history. **That's a warning sign for our democracy.** Why? Because Musk isn't just the richest person in the world. **He's one of the biggest political donors in the country, and he's already spent hundreds of millions of dollars trying to shape our elections and influence who governs us.** 1 To put his wealth in perspective: the typical American household would need more than 11 million years to earn what Musk has today. _No one_ should have that much money. clean_body: | | | Peter, Elon Musk just became the world's first trillionaire. After SpaceX's stock market debut last week, Musk now controls more wealth than any individual in human history. That's a warning sign for our democracy. Why? Because Musk isn't just the richest person in the world. He's one of the biggest political donors in the country, and he's already spent hundreds of millions of dollars trying to shape our elections and influence who governs us. 1 To put his wealth in perspective: the typical American household would need more than 11 million years to earn what Musk has today. No one should have that much money. And in a democracy, no one should have that much power. Musk didn't become a trillionaire on his own, Peter. His companies have benefited from billions in taxpayer support, government contracts, and public investments. 2 But now he's using his wealth to seek even more power. In the 2024 election cycle alone, Musk spent at least $288 million helping elect Donald Trump and other Republican candidates. 3 And he's already signaled that he intends to spend heavily in the 2026 midterms.4 That's why a trillionaire should concern every one of us. Because when so much wealth is concentrated in the hands of one person, so is power. Power to flood elections with money. Power to shape public debate. Power to make sure politicians listen to billionaires before they listen to working people. We've already seen what that looks like: After buying Twitter, Musk transformed it into a platform that amplifies right-wing misinformation and extremism.5 As head of Trump's so-called Department of Government Efficiency, he championed an agenda that weakened public institutions while protecting the interests of billionaires and large corporations. Now, with an even larger fortune behind him, he'll have more resources to influence elections, pressure policymakers, and protect a system that continues to reward the wealthy while leaving working families behind. But that's not a future we're willing to accept. For too long, working people have been stuck between MAGA Republicans who openly serve the wealthy, and establishment Democrats who are too comfortable with — and often cheer for — a political system dominated by corporate money. This broken political system is why we introduced our Working Families Guarantee — a blueprint for what it looks like when WFP leaders and champions answer to working people, not wealthy donors. We're building power in cities, towns, and neighborhoods where others have given up. And we're fighting for an economy and a democracy where workers have a real voice in the decisions that affect their lives. In solidarity, Working Families Party Sources: 1\. , Open Secrets , March 26, 2025 2\. , CNN , June 13, 2026 3\. , Washington Post , January 31, 2025 4\. , Politico , January 31, 2026 5\. , PBS News , August 13, 2024 Thoughts? clean_body: $1,000,000 in dark money being poured into our race | | | | | == | We found out today that another $800,000 in outside money is coming into this race to save our corporate-backed opponent, Diana DeGette. That brings the total outside spending against Melat to more than $1,000,000. | == Some of this dark money is coming from shell PACs that only just recently filed with the FEC in order to hide their funders from Denver voters. It could be AIPAC, Big Pharma, or any other special interest desperate to keep the status quo working for them and against working people. They know Melat will not take their money, answer their calls, or protect their bottom lines in Congress, so they're spending hundreds of thousands of dollars to stop her. Another PAC, one that's spending $400,000 against us, has deep ties to the party establishment. At a time when they should be putting every resource they have into taking back the House, the Senate, and holding Trump accountable, they are flying into Denver to save an incumbent who has taken this seat and its voters for granted. And the ads they're running are so xenophobic - saying Melat "doesn't belong in Denver" - you'd think they were paid for by MAGA Inc. or ICE. How is that fighting Donald Trump?! We do not have to outraise them dollar for dollar, but we do have to spend smarter, organize harder, and make sure Denver voters hear from us before they hear another lie from a dark money PAC. == | == | With your help, we will not let them buy this election. Team,
[Spotlight PA just reported](https://substack.com/redirect/ac004b3b-6dc1-4f8e-b834-1bf2e965818f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that Dan Meuser **purposefully excluded local leaders** from a meeting with DHS about the massive ICE detention centers planned for our part of PA - all because they weren't part of his party.
Dan said he was inviting **" just the Republican commissioners"** because **" if there's some positive messaging, I'd like it to come from you all."**
This meeting was supposed to provide clarity for local public officials about the giant ICE facilities threatening to wreak havoc on our rural towns. It was their chance to get answers to the questions residents had been asking for months and advocate for the people they represent.
**But Dan refused to let that happen. Because he wanted to control the messaging and spin it in his favor.**
Once again, _the only person Dan actually serves is himself._
We deserve so much better than this. Our communities should have a voice in decisions that will impact us for decades to come. We can't let Dan get away with shutting us out.
**[If you want to show Dan that we're fed up with his self-serving schemes, chip in to my campaign before our end-of-quarter deadline.](https://substack.com/redirect/d0832425-1f65-4e75-a279-38fd52209afe?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
Everything we raise by June 30 goes public. Let's send a message.
[TELL DAN YOU'RE DONE](https://substack.com/redirect/d0832425-1f65-4e75-a279-38fd52209afe?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Thank you,
Rachel Wallace

name: Veterans for Garrity
subject: Veterans are rallying behind Stacy Garrity.
body:
A standing-room-only crowd launched Veterans for Garrity. Watch the video and join the mission.

| | | | | |
---
| | | | | | Peter,

Last night, veterans, military families, and supporters packed VFW Post 7415 in New Cumberland for the official launch of Veterans for Garrity.
The standing-room-only crowd sent a clear message:
**Pennsylvania's veterans deserve a Governor who understands their service and will fight for them every day.**
---
| | | | |
---
| |
As a retired Army Reserve Colonel who served our nation for 30 years and deployed three times to the Middle East, Stacy Garrity knows firsthand the sacrifices made by the men and women who wear our nation's uniform.
That's why she announced a comprehensive plan to support Pennsylvania's 700,000 veterans through initiatives focused on healthcare, housing, jobs, property tax relief, and ensuring veterans have a strong voice in Harrisburg.
---
| |
_**YOU CAN READ MORE ABOUT STACY’S PLAN TO SUPPORT VETERANS HERE:**_
---
| [LEARN MORE](https://us.list-manage.com/vulg_4B6CuL?e=63ab67bb25&c2id=8377c90e3583a614e646f5b9492ea9fd)
---
| |
The energy in the room was incredible, but this is just the beginning.
Veterans for Garrity is building a statewide coalition to reach veterans in every corner of Pennsylvania and ensure they know they have a champion in Stacy Garrity.
---
|
---
| |
# YOU CAN WATCH A REPLAY OF THE EVENT HERE:
---
| [WATCH THE VIDEO](https://us.list-manage.com/6AP69ddSnkg?e=63ab67bb25&c2id=8377c90e3583a614e646f5b9492ea9fd)
---
| |
Building a statewide veterans coalition takes resources. It means organizing events, reaching veterans in all 67 counties, sharing Stacy's message, and ensuring the concerns of Pennsylvania's veterans are heard.
**If you believe Pennsylvania's veterans deserve a Governor who has walked in their boots and understands their service, please consider supporting Veterans for Garrity today.**
---
| [SUPPORT VETERANS FOR GARRITY](https://us.list-manage.com/11PnzUzoegP?e=63ab67bb25&c2id=8377c90e3583a614e646f5b9492ea9fd)
---
| |
Every contribution helps us reach more veterans, grow our coalition, and fight for the men and women who fought for us.
---
|
---
| |
Thank you for standing with Pennsylvania's veterans.
\- Team Garrity
_P.S. Last night's standing-room-only crowd proved that veterans across Pennsylvania are ready to get involved. Help us continue building this movement by making a contribution today._

Last week I had a powerful evening with Virginians for Reproductive Freedom.
I heard from a complex care OB-GYN about patients who are being forced to travel across state lines just to receive medically necessary care.
These weren’t elective procedures or controversial decisions. They were medically necessary care that their doctors determined they needed — but that politicians have made unavailable in their home state.
Let me make one thing clear: Healthcare decisions belong between patients and their doctors. Not politicians or MAGA extremists in Washington who have never spent a day in medical school but feel entitled to overrule the judgment of trained physicians caring for their patients.
I'm voting YES on the Virginia Reproductive Freedom Amendment this November. And I'm going to take that same energy to Congress.
Because while Virginia is fighting to protect reproductive freedom at the state level, MAGA Republicans in Washington are plotting their next move. A national abortion ban. Restrictions on contraception. Attacks on IVF. They haven't stopped — they've just temporarily regrouped.
My wife Dr. Annemarie Tull is a pediatrician. I watch her navigate a healthcare system that's increasingly being dictated by politicians instead of medical professionals. I see firsthand what happens when ideology overrules medicine.
It's wrong. And it has to stop.
My MAGA opponent, Rob Wittman, supports extreme abortion bans. He has spent 18 years in Congress voting to restrict women's access to healthcare. He doesn't trust women to make their own medical decisions and he's voted accordingly time and time again.
If you believe healthcare decisions belong between patients and their doctors, chip in $25, $50, or $100 right now. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/melltull4congress]

name: Kevin Fagan for Congress
subject: Conspiracy Charges and Data Centers; National Issues come to District 5
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Kevin Fagan for Congress
body:
We have seen story after story around the country of when a data center comes to town. They promise investment, but so often communities pay.

| | | | | [|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/oXTOpRHXJlD?e=e2b1441324&c2id=8faaa3708c7efcfa1f05aa8a758ea7fb)
| | | | | | | | | | | | | | | |

**No Hyperscale Data Centers in Spokane** **or District 5.**
We have seen story after story around the country of when a data center comes to town. They promise community investment, but so often communities pay the cost while shareholders benefit. Now, it has come to Spokane.
Avista recently announced a proposed 500 MW data center in Spokane County. This would add electrical load equivalent to 1/3 of Spokane County’s power demand. The process was paused due to significant community push back, but we need to take a larger look at whether a data center is right for our community at all.

Let me be clear: until the developers and utilities prove they can put people first in these projects, I am **opposed** to them, including this proposed 500 MW data center. center.

Our aquifer is already under pressure. Power demand across the West is growing faster than we can build clean generation. We need to conserve and protect these resources, not sell them off to the highest bidder. Our energy and water should go to people first.
We should continue to put pressure on local officials and those running for office to take a stance on this vital issue so I encourage readers to contact their City or County elected officials to let them know where you stand on this.
— Kevin

As a Progressive being able to directly address and take important stances on topics of universal healthcare, abolishing ICE, and more topics directly impacting our community is extremely important to me.

---
| | | | | | | | | | | |

**Asotin County Democrats Candidate Forum** Recently in Clarkston I had the chance to hear directly from and address some of our rural communities. We had real discussions about healthcare, agriculture, jobs, and education. It was great hearing from the people of Clarkston and their concerns around rural agriculture and the right to repair as well as public land conservation. Rural communities are not to be forgotten about; they play a huge part in District 5 and I am committed to making sure their voices are heard.

---
| |
Come down to the MLK Center on Saturday June 20th for a community-wide Juneteenth Celebration!Juneteenth recognizes the day in 1865 where Union soldiers told the last enslaved people in Texas that they were free. But the work did not stop there and it still does not stop today. We need to continue to show up and support our communities in their march towards justice.

Come celebrate Father’s Day and the Summer Solstice with an evening bike ride around Spokane!
This is a great opportunity to connect with neighbors and meet new people. I’ll see you out there!

# Kevin’s Take
---
| |
A few weeks ago, a federal jury in Spokane returned a guilty verdict against Jac Archer, Justice Forral, and Bajun Mavalwalla II for their actions on June 11, 2025. These three neighbors, dubbed the “Spokane 3,” peacefully protested against the forceful removal of two young Venezuelan men who were in this country legally. Like many of us, they believed in their right to protest, and when they acted within their Constitutionally-protected rights, the federal government successfully prosecuted them on conspiracy charges. Despite a guilty verdict, this prosecution represents a violation of Constitutional rights and federal overreach. When the federal government blatantly ignores Constitutional provisions, it undermines the very principles this nation was founded on. The Constitution is only as strong as those entrusted to uphold it, and when those very people fail to do so, the rights of _every_ American are jeopardized. What good is a government if it refuses to honor the very Constitution it swore to defend?I stand with Jac, Justice, and Bajun and I will continue to do so no matter what comes next. Our right to assemble, to speak, and to stand up for your neighbor is not conditional, and a guilty verdict does not diminish them; it only tests whether the government still answers to the people, or if it has turned against them.

| | Energy bills are too high, and Trump's approach of doubling down on fossil fuels is making it worse. This month, I introduced three bills that tackle the energy affordability crisis head-on by supporting affordable clean energy and protecting American consumers from price-gouging natural gas exports. Here's what each bill does: **Restoring Renewable Energy Parity Act:** President Trump has spent the past year attacking wind and solar through a series of executive orders — blocking permits, launching bogus national security investigations into wind turbine imports, and delaying reviews for over 100 wind projects. This bill repeals those orders and prohibits the administration from reissuing substantially similar ones. **Protecting Americans from High Electricity Prices Act:** Right now, energy companies can get approval to export American natural gas overseas, even when doing so drives up prices for families here at home. This bill reforms the Department of Energy's approval process so that no new liquefied natural gas (LNG) export terminal can be approved if it will raise energy costs for American consumers. It also requires the agency to account for climate emissions in those decisions. **Renewable Energy Choice Act:** Believe it or not, roughly 15–20% of U.S. counties have local restrictions that prevent solar, wind, or geothermal energy from connecting to the grid. This bill puts a stop to that and ensures states and localities can't block Americans from accessing clean, affordable, renewable energy in their own communities. Taken together, these bills stand up to Trump's reckless energy agenda, remove the roadblocks to affordable clean power, and help lower costs for working families. Peter, Last weekend, I got to spend one of my favorite days of the year exactly where I wanted to be: back home in Rockford celebrating Pride. And let me tell you, _Rockford knows how to celebrate._ [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/133528792/628174889/526203646?refcode=em-6.17.26-all-c&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS85MzkwNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxNmM4NWY4Ny05NjZhLWYxMTEtOGZjYi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Bbre294qvKKRomGRjtjvJkK9PCDbGqA1yI81xg0u7-o=) Thousands of neighbors, friends, families, and community members came together to celebrate love, acceptance, and the simple idea that everyone deserves to be treated with dignity and respect. There were rainbow flags everywhere, kids running around with face paint, local organizations sharing resources, and plenty of hugs from people I've known for years. As I walked through the crowd, I couldn't help but think about how much has changed.There was a time when I never imagined I'd be able to live openly as a gay man, let alone represent my hometown in Congress. Like so many LGBTQ+ people, I grew up wondering whether there would be a place for me. Whether I could be accepted. Whether I could build a life where I didn't have to hide who I was. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/133528797/628174892/526203646?refcode=em-6.17.26-all-c&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS85MzkwNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxNmM4NWY4Ny05NjZhLWYxMTEtOGZjYi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Bbre294qvKKRomGRjtjvJkK9PCDbGqA1yI81xg0u7-o=) I saw that spirit everywhere at Rockford. This city shaped who I am, taught me the value of looking out for your neighbors, and ultimately gave me the opportunity to serve. Being able to come back and celebrate Pride with this community is something I never take for granted. To everyone who came out this weekend: **thank you**. And to those who did not or could not, I hope to see you there next year. And to every LGBTQ+ person reading this: whether you're celebrating your first Pride or your fiftieth, know that you are loved, you belong, and there are millions of people standing with you. Patriot,
Flanked by the Acting Attorney General at DOJ headquarters, DHS Secretary Markwayne Mullin just stood before cameras, stone-faced but emotional, and said it plainly:
_**"As a father of six, three of them young girls, I’ll do whatever it takes. I’ll move heaven and hell to go find these kids.”** _
He laid out in horrific detail the tragic fate of **at least 450,000 children** – from their journey to our previously broken border to their transfer to unvetted sponsors.
Over a third of the females, regardless of age, were reportedly sexually assaulted before they even reached the border.
And once here, **65,605 reports of abuse and neglect were filed and left to sit** – among them, 7,346 reports of human trafficking. __**Ignored.** _ _
Some of these children reported being raped **over 600 times.**
"Neglect at best, criminal at worst," as Secretary Mullin called it.
**146,000 have been located so far, but hundreds of thousands are still unaccounted for.**
These are not statistics – _they are children_.
I don't share this to politicize things, or to paralyze you. I share it because it demands a response.
My name is Dennis Price. I'm a Marine special operator with over 19 years of service and 15 overseas deployments both in the military and private contracting, and I’m writing to you today as Founder and CEO of Heroes for Humanity.
**We were forged in the fire of the 2021 Afghanistan withdrawal, when I went behind enemy lines to bring 77 Americans and Afghan allies home. Today we are a 501(c)(3) network of veteran special operators, first responders, medical professionals and everyday people committed to being the hands and feet of Jesus Christ.**
Since 2026 began, we have conducted **anti-trafficking operations across 11 states** and as you read this, we’re deployed – boots on the ground – working as a quick reaction force alongside trusted local partners for the World Cup – a magnet for trafficking the scale of which we’ve never seen. **Already we’ve rescued 14 trafficking victims leading to multiple arrests.**
The skills that made our operators effective in combat overseas – surveillance, network mapping, moving through hostile environments, finding people who do not want to be found – are exactly the skills we’re now putting to use to find vulnerable young women and children.
**We know how to find them and bring them home –** _**but we need your prayers and support.** _

disclaimer_text: Paid for by Julia Letlow for Louisiana
body:
New law prohibits statewide elected officials from being paid by lobbying and consulting firms while serving in office

| | |
---
| | | | [|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/Nm5lqIK5i9h?e=95355a072c&c2id=cd64ea42b1b0eeac0fd7d107db75288a)
| | | | | | **FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE** June 17, 2026katherine@julialetlow.com
**LETLOW CALLS ON FLEMING TO RESIGN FROM DC LOBBYING FIRM** _New law prohibits statewide elected officials from being paid by lobbying and consulting firms while serving in office_
**BATON ROUGE, LA** — Congresswoman Julia Letlow is calling on State Treasurer John Fleming to immediately comply with Louisiana's newly enacted ethics law by either resigning from the McKeon Lobbying Group or resigning as State Treasurer.
Governor Jeff Landry has signed House Bill 210 into law, strengthening Louisiana's ethics code and prohibiting statewide elected officials from being paid to lobby, advise, or consult while serving in statewide office.
The new law has immediate implications for State Treasurer John Fleming.
Fleming joined The McKeon Group, a Washington lobbying and consulting firm, as a registered lobbyist in 2021, and is still on their payroll as an advisor. During the Louisiana U.S. Senate debate, Fleming acknowledged that he receives monthly payments from the firm while simultaneously serving as Louisiana State Treasurer.
According to Fleming’s [financial disclosure](https://us.list-manage.com/YmrU0Jh3nND?e=95355a072c&c2id=cd64ea42b1b0eeac0fd7d107db75288a) forms, he was paid over $40,000 by the firm in 2024, while also receiving his taxpayer-funded salary from Louisiana.
---
| | | | |
---
| | | | | | | | | | | | _"The law is clear. John Fleming cannot continue serving as State Treasurer while being paid by a Washington lobbying and consulting firm,"_ **said Congresswoman Julia Letlow.**_"Governor Landry and the Legislature have made clear that statewide elected officials should be serving the people who elected them, not collecting checks from DC lobbying firms. John Fleming should either resign from the McKeon Group or resign as State Treasurer."_
The new law leaves Fleming with a straightforward choice: end his relationship with the Washington lobbying firm or step down from statewide office. Fleming has maintained there is nothing improper about being paid by a Washington lobbying and consulting firm while serving as Louisiana State Treasurer. Governor Landry has now signed legislation making clear that such arrangements are prohibited for statewide elected officials.

Friend,

Who is Ayn Rand?

Most people know her as the author of The Fountainhead and Atlas Shrugged. But she was so much more than a novelist. She was a revolutionary philosopher who inspired both ardent admirers and fierce detractors.

Her book, _Atlas Shrugged_ , is cited as one of the most influential books in the last century.

So who is this woman behind all the controversy?

The Atlas Society teaches people about Ayn Rand, her life, her groundbreaking philosophy, and why her literature is more relevant today than ever.

The Life of Ayn Rand

Ayn Rand was born Alyssa Rosenbalm on February 2nd, 1905, in St. Petersburg, Russia.

At 12 years old, she and her two little sisters witnessed the first shots of the Russian Revolution from the window of their apartment. What she witnessed later, living under Soviet rule, would have a profound impact on her writing and philosophy.

On the eve of her 22nd birthday, she got a passport to Chicago to visit relatives, never to return to Russia again.

Ayn Rand got her start as a writer in Hollywood, working on many screenplays and short stories, two of which would become Broadway plays. When one of her plays was made into a movie and the studio turned her hero into a villain, she was inspired to write a novel about a visionary architect who would not compromise his creative vision for the sake of others: The Foundationhead.

**Much like Ayn Rand, The Atlas Society refused to compromise our vision of bringing her philosophy to new audiences.**

We have made it our mission to bring Ayn Rand's ideas to life for young people, and we do it by transforming Ayn Rand's work into a variety of vehicles that appeal most to them.

Now more than ever before, younger generations need to understand the ideas of individual liberty, free market economics, and sound philosophy.

**Through our graphic novels, pocket guides, animated videos, digital content, and educational programs and conferences, we are reaching tens of millions of young minds.**

Ayn Rand wrote her magnum opus, _Atlas Shrugged_ , at a time when America began romanticizing socialism _(much as we are seeing again today)._

The novel was the fullest dramatic encapsulation of her philosophic ideas, that man is a heroic being who should pursue his own happiness, neither sacrificing himself to others nor sacrificing others to himself.

She called this philosophy Objectivism and went on to further elaborate it in dozens of essays, books, and public appearances.

In the final years of her life, Rand had this to say,

**" The elaboration of a philosophical system is a job that no philosopher can finish in his lifetime. There is still an awful lot of work to be done."**

The Atlas Society is continuing her work by delivering her joyous vision of the world and life's glorious possibilities to new audiences. It's a vision that resonates anew with each new reader who discovers her novels for the first time, and through them, discovers a new vision for themselves as individuals.

clean_body: Friend, Who is Ayn Rand? Most people know her as the author of The Fountainhead and Atlas Shrugged. But she was so much more than a novelist. She was a revolutionary philosopher who inspired both ardent admirers and fierce detractors. Her book, Atlas Shrugged , is cited as one of the most influential books in the last century. So who is this woman behind all the controversy? The Atlas Society teaches people about Ayn Rand, her life, her groundbreaking philosophy, and why her literature is more relevant today than ever. Friend, if you are curious about the life and philosophy of Ayn Rand, click below to watch this video or keep reading. The Life of Ayn Rand Ayn Rand was born Alyssa Rosenbalm on February 2nd, 1905, in St. Petersburg, Russia. At 12 years old, she and her two little sisters witnessed the first shots of the Russian Revolution from the window of their apartment. What she witnessed later, living under Soviet rule, would have a profound impact on her writing and philosophy. On the eve of her 22nd birthday, she got a passport to Chicago to visit relatives, never to return to Russia again. Ayn Rand got her start as a writer in Hollywood, working on many screenplays and short stories, two of which would become Broadway plays. When one of her plays was made into a movie and the studio turned her hero into a villain, she was inspired to write a novel about a visionary architect who would not compromise his creative vision for the sake of others: The Foundationhead. Much like Ayn Rand, The Atlas Society refused to compromise our vision of bringing her philosophy to new audiences. We have made it our mission to bring Ayn Rand's ideas to life for young people, and we do it by transforming Ayn Rand's work into a variety of vehicles that appeal most to them. Now more than ever before, younger generations need to understand the ideas of individual liberty, free market economics, and sound philosophy. Through our graphic novels, pocket guides, animated videos, digital content, and educational programs and conferences, we are reaching tens of millions of young minds. Ayn Rand wrote her magnum opus, Atlas Shrugged , at a time when America began romanticizing socialism (much as we are seeing again today). The novel was the fullest dramatic encapsulation of her philosophic ideas, that man is a heroic being who should pursue his own happiness, neither sacrificing himself to others nor sacrificing others to himself. She called this philosophy Objectivism and went on to further elaborate it in dozens of essays, books, and public appearances. In the final years of her life, Rand had this to say, " The elaboration of a philosophical system is a job that no philosopher can finish in his lifetime. There is still an awful lot of work to be done." The Atlas Society is continuing her work by delivering her joyous vision of the world and life's glorious possibilities to new audiences. It's a vision that resonates anew with each new reader who discovers her novels for the first time, and through them, discovers a new vision for themselves as individuals. At The Atlas Society, we've set out to engage a BILLION young minds with the ideas of Ayn Rand. You can help by clicking any button below and donating today. With grit, grace, and gratitude, Jennifer Anju Grossman (JAG) CEO, The Atlas Society The Atlas Society is a 501(c)(3) Not For Profit Organization. Some economists make you feel dumber. [Justin Wolfers](https://open.substack.com/users/495098019-justin-wolfers?utm_source=mentions) makes you feel smarter--and he does it while cracking jokes about wombats, OnlyFans, and Cliff's handsome eyes. The University of Michigan economist (you may know him from his Platypus Economics Substack, or from being the rare economist who's actually funny on TV) sat down with [Cliff Schecter](https://open.substack.com/users/31941177-cliff-schecter?utm_source=mentions) and [David Shuster](https://open.substack.com/users/16891317-david-shuster?utm_source=mentions) for an hour that somehow makes the economy, AI, inflation, and the future of work genuinely fun to think about.
This is the conversation that finally untangles why the stock market is soaring while your paycheck buys less, what an AI economy actually does to people like you, and whether your kids are going to be okay.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuYmx1ZWFtcC5jby9zdWJzY3JpYmU_.j_uFTOrKD9l9fiQ2TQqc70FVQYOibXGs6VY7-4LcTGQ?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=202454026)
And then he starts doing math you can't unhear. Wolfers walks through exactly how Elon Musk bought the 2024 election--for 0.026% of his fortune, the equivalent of you finding $50 in the couch cushions, with enough left over to buy 3,819 more. Elections, that is, not couches.
He explains why AI is the first revolution that comes for [brains instead of brawn](https://substack.com/redirect/14b5f5c6-b6df-4105-8cd7-33b973ba9d95?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) ("I now know what it meant to be a Detroit autoworker in the 1970s"), why you should stop being pro-business and start being pro-competition, and why, as an economist, he thinks January 6th was one of the most dangerous things a president has ever done. You cannot summarize this one. You have to watch it.

clean_body: = The first time I played wheelchair basketball for Team USA in the Paralympics, we lost. Seventh place was devastating. But I kept pushing. Working out. Honing my craft. Getting better. The next time I represented Team USA, we won a bronze medal. Then gold medals in 2016 and 2021. I’ll be honest: losing sucks. So when I ran for State House, I did everything I could to win. I crawled up stairs to talk to voters, pulling my wheelchair behind me. And I won — twice. (In a district Donald Trump won!) That’s the type of hard work and focus that helped me become the Democratic nominee for U.S. Senate in Iowa. And it’s how we will flip this open seat in November. But in order to win, we need to attract donors from all around the country to fund our operation and invest in this campaign. # Breaking: Central Banks Accelerate Gold Purchases
**A growing global trend is prompting questions about long-term dollar exposure.** Dear Reader, In a recent appearance on Fox Business with Liz Claman, Peter Schiff raised concerns about the direction of the U.S. dollar and America's financial outlook. He pointed to a trend that's difficult to ignore: Central banks around the world have been increasing their gold reserves while reducing their holdings of U.S. dollars and Treasuries. That's not a good sign. His view is that the next period of financial strain may be centered more heavily in the United States rather than overseas. Regardless of opinions, one fact remains: Global central banks have been accumulating gold at levels not seen in decades. For generations, gold has been used as a tangible monetary asset during periods of currency uncertainty and economic transition. Making sure you saw this message from Paul Eaton
#
Peter, Paul Eaton reached out on Monday about Trump's "deal" with Iran. You can find that email below.
He led troops in Iraq. He knows what war looks like. His verdict on Trump's Iran War? America LOST, and Iran is in stronger a position because of it. Watch Eaton's take on Trump's deal here:
[](https://act.votevets.org/go/2927?c0=vv-pac-em-june26-paul-eaton.LobCn4&refcode=em260617-1-120&t=1&akid=35245%2E3013755%2Ez8TYgk)

---

* * *

Peter —
I spent a career leading Americans into harm’s way. The hardest decision in our Republic — whether to send them at all — the Constitution gives to Congress, the body closest to the people who do the dying, so that no one man can spend American lives on his own say-so.
This President spent them anyway. Thirteen Americans are dead and over three hundred wounded. Gas crossed four dollars a gallon — a dollar higher than the day before he started. We drained the missiles and interceptors we would need to deter China, stockpiles our own commanders say will take years to rebuild. The Strait of Hormuz, open before this war, was shut for the first time in its history. And the brutal regime in Tehran is stronger today than the day he attacked it.
And when the House voted on a bipartisan basis to rein him in, he called it “meaningless.” That is the truth of this man: he does not want to win the argument over war. He wants no argument at all. And he is not finished. He has already seized the head of state of Venezuela, and he muses openly about Cuba, about Greenland, about Mexico — boasting that “nobody can stop us.”
Well, someone must. That power is on the ballot in November. The most important thing the American people can do is elect a Democratic Congress with the spine to make him ask — and the votes to say no. Not a symbolic resolution he can wave away. One he cannot ignore.
That is the definitive objective of VoteVets, from this point until November. Our democracy itself is on the line, and all of us must do whatever we can to defend it.

name: Becky Cooper
subject: We read every email
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Friends of Francesca Hong
body:
A note from Fran's campaign manager
# [](https://francescahong.com?refcode=em20260617-2927)
Peter,
Becky here, Fran's campaign manager. I don't usually write these emails myself, but I wanted to share something with you.
We're just over halfway through Pride Month, and the Supreme Court could hand down rulings on trans rights any day now. A few weeks ago, a message came into the campaign from a man named Robert. He told us he likes Fran's platform and everything she stands for.
But he also said he was worried that standing up for trans people might cost Democrats too many votes. That it's "all too new," that not enough is known, and maybe trans issues could be a holdup.
He said he’s never sent an email like this before. But he ended with this: _"I believe we are all created equal. I want change badly. This country needs it tremendously."_
I could tell he was wrestling with something real. So I wrote back — not as a campaign manager, but as a mom. Here's what I said:
* * *
_Hi Robert,_
_My son came out as trans to our family in 2014. I'll be the first to admit I made mistakes. I never hesitated to love and support him — but I was deeply afraid for his safety._
_After Trump was elected the first time, that fear grew. He wasn't just under physical threat, but a constant emotional onslaught from people's ill-informed attacks. Even after he left for college, I texted him every morning just to make sure he was still alive. It was one of the scariest times of my life as a parent._
_But the more he became himself, the better we all felt. He grew confident in who he is. He bought a house, found a job he loves, made great friends. And a lot of people came to understand what I already knew — that trans folks are tremendously normal, even boring. They just want to live their lives._
_We've now entered a second wave, much more hostile than the first. After the relief we'd felt, it's especially harsh. And I'm afraid again._
_When politicians like Gavin Newsom choose to sacrifice trans people to win over a few voters, here's what I hear: that they'll sacrifice anyone who becomes inconvenient. Racial minorities. People with disabilities. Immigrants. The poor. Our elders. Whoever is in the way._
_When Fran stands up for trans people, I know she'll fight for everyone — not just when it's easy or popular, but always. That's why I chose to work for this campaign. And it's why I'm proud to call her a friend._
* * *
That's the kind of leader Wisconsin deserves. Whatever battle you're fighting, the way Fran stands up for trans people is the way she'll stand up for you.
**[If that's the kind of leadership you want too, please consider supporting our campaign with a contribution today.](https://act.francescahong.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_fh_20260617.IuvFXS&refcode=em20260617-2927&t=1&akid=2927%2E105371%2EwbBw9P)**
Thank you for being part of this.
**[Donate $5 ››](https://act.francescahong.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_fh_20260617.IuvFXS&amount=5&refcode=em20260617-2927&t=4&akid=2927%2E105371%2EwbBw9P)**
With gratitude,
— Becky
**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_fh_footer?refcode=em20260617-2927&t=5&refcode2=2927_105371_wbBw9P&akid=2927%2E105371%2EwbBw9P)**

When politicians like Gavin Newsom choose to sacrifice trans people to win over a few voters, here's what I hear: that they'll sacrifice anyone who becomes inconvenient. Racial minorities. People with disabilities. Immigrants. The poor. Our elders. Whoever is in the way. When Fran stands up for trans people, I know she'll fight for everyone — not just when it's easy or popular, but always. That's why I chose to work for this campaign. And it's why I'm proud to call her a friend. That's the kind of leader Wisconsin deserves. Whatever battle you're fighting, the way Fran stands up for trans people is the way she'll stand up for you. Thank you for being part of this. With gratitude, — Becky Email us: mailto:info@francescahong.com

| | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18] | | | | | | You could be losing money every swipe thanks to high interest But these cards flip the script: 0% APR intro period on purchases and balance transfers. [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/PNG%202023%20TOP%20Newsletter%20Header.png]
Lea el boletín en español abajo [#Español]
Celebrate Juneteenth with TOP
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Galveston%202025%20-%20slim.jpg]
Juneteenth is not just a reminder of delayed freedom; it’s a reminder of indomitable Black spirit. It's a day rooted in the power we have always had within us. And as TOP gears up to celebrate later this week, we are channeling the ancestors we stand on the shoulders of, and working tirelessly toward a future where race and class are no longer barriers to justice and opportunity.
Join TOP staff and members at the following events.
Dallas
Saturday, June 20
Juneteenth Festival at Halperin Park
11 a.m. - 1 p.m.
Bridge Deck Park (626 S R.L. Thornton Fwy, I-35E, Dallas, TX 75203)
Contact: Jet - (469) 550-4750
Houston
Thursday, June 18
BLD PWR's "Living Room Experience" with Kendrick Sampson
Doors open at 3 p.m. Program starts at 4 p.m.
The Blank Canvas Space (2955 Gulf Fwy, Houston, TX)
Contact: Andres - (281) 810-1528
Friday, June 19
"Juneteenth: The Reunion" celebration at Emancipation Park
3 - 7 p.m.
3018 Emancipation Ave, Houston, TX
Contact: Andres - (281) 810-1528
San Antonio
Saturday, June 20
Tabling at Comanche Park after the Juneteenth parade
Two shift opportunities: 11 a.m. - 1 p.m.; 1 - 3 p.m.
2600 Rigsby Ave, San Antonio, TX 78222
Contact: Michael N. - (210) 607-9394
That's a wrap! TOP and partners host a movie screening and panel on data centers
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Data%20center%20event%20Dallas%20-%20slim.jpg]
TOP, Sunrise Movement Dallas, Southern Sector Rising, and Downwinders at Risk held a film screening and community discussion on data centers this past Thursday, June 11, at the historic Texas Theatre in Dallas. A panel featuring Brianna Brown (TOP Executive Director), Clay Jenkins (Dallas County Judge), KeShaun Pearson (Executive Director of Memphis Community Against Pollution), Danny Cendejas (Campaign Specialist with Media Justice), and Kendra Seawright (Women’s March Rural Organizer) led the discussion.
Across the country, a boom in new data centers is reshaping local energy grids, water systems, and land use. This rapid growth is often happening with little public information about the long-term impacts new data centers could bring for nearby residents. Texas is the fastest-growing data center market in the nation , and with reports of health, infrastructure, and resource concerns stemming from the building of these centers, Texans want answers as well as what this means for the future of their families.
👉🏾 View event photos here. [https://www.facebook.com/share/p/17j67P6kx4/]
ADD YOUR NAME: Support a platform that lifts up ALL Texans
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/ORN%20survey%20-%20slim.jpg]
If we want to stop harmful actions on our democracy and communities, we need millions of people fighting back together in peaceful and impactful ways. That's why TOP is proud to team up with our friends at the Organizing Revival Network to share their Willing to Fight Pledge, as we look to unite Texans on a vision that moves ALL communities forward.
👉🏾 ACT NOW: Take the pledge today! [https://toptx.us/orn]
TOP Tip: Check out our playlist for Black Music Month
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Black%20Music%20Month%20Spotify%20-%20slim.jpg]
June is Black Music Month , and at TOP, we're commemorating it with a Texas twist. Check out and save our BlackTOP Black Music Month - Texas Edition playlist on Spotify! [https://open.spotify.com/playlist/0s5u5hH3oq8RES5xQkTz4f] 🤠
https://secure.everyaction.com/_ew4evGgs0i4Ml7-RjD4tQ2 [https://secure.everyaction.com/_ew4evGgs0i4Ml7-RjD4tQ2]
Español
Celebra el juneteenth con TOP
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Galveston%202025%20-%20slim.jpg]
Juneteenth no es solo un recordatorio de una libertad que llegó con retraso; es un recordatorio del espíritu indomable de la comunidad afrodescendiente. Es un día arraigado en el poder que siempre hemos llevado dentro de nosotros. Y mientras TOP se prepara para celebrar esta semana, honramos a los ancestros sobre cuyos hombros nos sostenemos y trabajamos incansablemente por un futuro en el que la raza y la clase social ya no sean barreras para la justicia y las oportunidades.
Acompaña al personal y a los miembros de TOP en los siguientes eventos.
Dallas
Sábado, 20 de junio
Festival de Juneteenth en Halperin Park
11 a.m. - 1 p.m.
Bridge Deck Park, 626 S R.L. Thornton Fwy, I-35E, Dallas, TX 75203
Contacto: Jet - (469) 550-4750
Houston

Evento "Living Room Experience" de BLD PWR con Kendrick Sampson

3 p.m. - 7 p.m.
3018 Emancipation Ave, Houston, TX
Contacto: Andres - (281) 810-1528
San Antonio
Sábado, 20 de junio
Mesa informativa en Comanche Park tras el desfile de Juneteenth

2600 Rigsby Ave, San Antonio, TX 78222

Eso es todo! TOP y sus socios organizaron una proyección de película y un panel sobre centros de datos
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Data%20center%20event%20Dallas%20-%20slim.jpg]
TOP, Sunrise Movement Dallas, Southern Sector Rising y Downwinders at Risk organizaron una proyección de película y un debate comunitario sobre los centros de datos el pasado jueves 11 de junio en el histórico Texas Theatre de Dallas . La charla fue dirigido por un panel compuesto por Brianna Brown (directora ejecutiva de TOP), Clay Jenkins (juez del condado de Dallas), KeShaun Pearson (director ejecutivo de Memphis Community Against Pollution), Danny Cendejas (especialista en campañas de Media Justice) y Kendra Seawright (organizadora rural de Women’s March).
En todo el país, el crecimiento acelerado de nuevos centros de datos está transformando las redes eléctricas locales, los sistemas de agua y el uso del suelo. Este rápido crecimiento suele ocurrir con poca información pública sobre los impactos a largo plazo que estos centros de datos podrían tener en las comunidades cercanas. Texas es el mercado de centros de datos de más rápido crecimiento en la nación y, ante los reportes sobre preocupaciones relacionadas con la salud, la infraestructura y los recursos derivados de la construcción de estos centros, los tejanos quieren respuestas y quieren saber qué significa esto para el futuro de sus familias.
👉🏾 Vea las fotos del evento aquí. [http://www.facebook.com/share/p/17j67P6kx4/]
AÑADE TU NOMBRE: Apoya una plataforma que impulsa a TODOS los tejanos
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/ORN%20survey%20-%20slim.jpg]
Si queremos detener las acciones perjudiciales contra nuestra democracia y nuestras comunidades, necesitamos que millones de personas se unan para responder de manera pacífica y efectiva. Por eso, TOP se enorgullece de colaborar con nuestros aliados de Organizing Revival Network para compartir su Compromiso de Luchar, mientras buscamos unir a las y los tejanos en torno a una visión que impulse el progreso de TODAS las comunidades.
👉🏾 ¡ACTÚA AHORA: Firma el compromiso hoy mismo! [https://toptx.us/orn]
Consejos de TOP: Echa un vistazo a nuestra lista de reproducción para el Mes de la Música Afrodescendiente
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Black%20Music%20Month%20Spotify%20-%20slim.jpg]
Junio es el Mes de la Música Afrodescendiente y en TOP lo celebramos con un toque tejano. ¡Echa un vistazo a nuestra lista de reproducción BlackTOP's Black Music Month - Texas Edition en Spotify y guárdala! [https://open.spotify.com/playlist/0s5u5hH3oq8RES5xQkTz4f] 🤠

name: Pramila Jayapal
subject: My Campaign Launch
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Pramila for Congress
body:
I’m so grateful to everyone who turned out to join us last night!
# [](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/892?refcode=em20260617-6366-footer&t=1&akid=6366%2E420207%2Ezi1JZq)
Peter,
**Last night we officially kicked off my 2026 campaign with an event right here in Seattle — and I’m so grateful to everyone who turned out to join us!**
[](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-em-20260617.GOaejG&refcode=em20260617-6366&t=2&akid=6366%2E420207%2Ezi1JZq)
Make no mistake, we have our work cut out for us this year. This event was about coming together to jumpstart the fight ahead.
Every single day, we watch Trump and his MAGA extremists try to pull this country backward, weaponizing our government, stoking the fires of xenophobia, and dismantling the very fabric of our Constitution. They prop up corporate billionaires while working families struggle to pay rent.
But despite all this damage, it has also done one service: to show that their ideas _do not work_ and the American people _do not want them._
So while it’s easy to feel despair, I didn’t come to Congress to despair. **I came to fight.** To protect our democracy and make it better for working people.
It’s not enough for Democrats to just be the anti-Trump party. We need to be a proposition party that stands FOR something — a working class agenda that includes Medicare for All, a living wage, reproductive freedom, just immigration reform, climate action, and more.
**We need to be a party that takes on corporate monopolies, war profiteers, the CEOs who dock their yachts here in Seattle but refuse to raise wages or respect unions.**
But the billionaires profiting from the status quo, the corporate interests, MAGA extremists and forces of regression aren’t taking any days off, and neither can we. They are going to spend hundreds of millions of dollars to prop their candidates up. AIPAC is hiring in Seattle right now to come after progressive candidates, and right-wing billionaires are already pouring dark money into races across the country.
**We need to be ready to take them on and win.**
[**That’s why today, I’m asking you to pitch in $3 or any amount to help power our progressive movement. I don’t take money from corporate PACs — it’s grassroots supporters like you who make this work possible.**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-em-20260617.GOaejG&refcode=em20260617-6366&amount=3&t=3&akid=6366%2E420207%2Ezi1JZq)
**[Contribute $3](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-em-20260617.GOaejG&amount=3&refcode=em20260617-6366&t=22&akid=6366%2E420207%2Ezi1JZq)**
Thank you, thank you, thank you for your support.
Pramila Jayapal
**[Contribute](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pj-email-footer?refcode=em20260617-6366-footer&t=23&refcode2=6366_420207_zi1JZq&akid=6366%2E420207%2Ezi1JZq)**

Peter,
I’m writing to ask you to chip in $15 to help Hakeem Jeffries and House Democrats win back the majority. Please let me tell you why I think this moment is different, and why your support here matters so much.
Winning the House isn’t just the top priority for Democrats right now. It’s the most direct path to restoring some basic accountability in Washington, and to proving that the chaos of the last few years isn’t some kind of permanent new normal.
I’ve spent a lot of time reflecting on what really makes America great. It’s not that we’ve always gotten it right. It’s that we’ve built a system of governance around the idea that leaders must be accountable to the people – not the other way around. It’s our revolutionary promise of political equality, economic opportunity, and personal liberty.
That’s what’s on the line.

body:
Without Chris Pappas winning in New Hampshire, Democrats won’t have a chance at taking back a majority in the Senate.
Peter, it’s Governor JB Pritzker.
I’m emailing you today about New Hampshire’s Senate race because this is serious: **Senate Republicans’ hand-picked candidate, John Sununu, jumped in to defeat Chris Pappas and flip this open Senate seat red.**
**[Before I go any further, I have to ask: Will you split $10 or more between Chris Pappas and Heartland Patriots to keep New Hampshire blue?](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/105172?refcode=em20260617-10584&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=10584%2E614464%2EYPxVbz)**
_Without Chris Pappas winning in New Hampshire, Democrats won’t have a chance at taking back a majority in the Senate._ That’s why this race is being targeted by GOP super PACs and Republicans across the country.
The NRSC — which pours millions into electing Republicans to the Senate — said they’re “all-in” on John Sununu. And polling shows: This race is a _statistical dead heat_ between Chris Pappas and John Sununu.

Hey, it's Harry.
I cannot believe we're just 6 days from this election.
Between early voting and vote-by-mail, thousands of Marylanders are already making their choice on who is best equipped to protect our democracy and serve MD-05 in Congress.
But MAGA-funded super PACs made their choice a long time ago -- and spoiler alert -- **it 's not me.**
That's why they're pouring MILLIONS of dollars into this race. When we began this campaign, I promised to serve the people and combat MAGA-extremism in every single one of its nasty forms.
_That makes me pretty unpopular with these guys:_
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/c56876d0-ce08-4b70-abb4-00086ce85642?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

**And here 's the part that keeps me up at night:** this is the SAME super PAC that poured in MILLIONS to defeat me in 2024.
They drowned me out once before, and they're betting it'll work again.
But this time is different. We have a plan to beat them -- and it starts with hitting our $1 million pre-primary goal so we can keep our ads on the air and reach undecided voters across MD-05 in these final days.

Harry

**Born and raised in the Twin Cities, Royce White was the son of a single mother and started playing sports at the age of 5 years old. Friend,

Who is Ayn Rand?

Most people know her as the author of The Fountainhead and Atlas Shrugged. But she was so much more than a novelist. She was a revolutionary philosopher who inspired both ardent admirers and fierce detractors.

Her book, _Atlas Shrugged_ , is cited as one of the most influential books in the last century.

So who is this woman behind all the controversy?

The Atlas Society teaches people about Ayn Rand, her life, her groundbreaking philosophy, and why her literature is more relevant today than ever.

The Life of Ayn Rand

Ayn Rand was born Alyssa Rosenbalm on February 2nd, 1905, in St. Petersburg, Russia.

At 12 years old, she and her two little sisters witnessed the first shots of the Russian Revolution from the window of their apartment. What she witnessed later, living under Soviet rule, would have a profound impact on her writing and philosophy.

On the eve of her 22nd birthday, she got a passport to Chicago to visit relatives, never to return to Russia again.

Ayn Rand got her start as a writer in Hollywood, working on many screenplays and short stories, two of which would become Broadway plays. When one of her plays was made into a movie and the studio turned her hero into a villain, she was inspired to write a novel about a visionary architect who would not compromise his creative vision for the sake of others: The Foundationhead.

**Much like Ayn Rand, The Atlas Society refused to compromise our vision of bringing her philosophy to new audiences.**

We have made it our mission to bring Ayn Rand's ideas to life for young people, and we do it by transforming Ayn Rand's work into a variety of vehicles that appeal most to them.

Now more than ever before, younger generations need to understand the ideas of individual liberty, free market economics, and sound philosophy.

**Through our graphic novels, pocket guides, animated videos, digital content, and educational programs and conferences, we are reaching tens of millions of young minds.**

Ayn Rand wrote her magnum opus, _Atlas Shrugged_ , at a time when America began romanticizing socialism _(much as we are seeing again today)._

The novel was the fullest dramatic encapsulation of her philosophic ideas, that man is a heroic being who should pursue his own happiness, neither sacrificing himself to others nor sacrificing others to himself.

She called this philosophy Objectivism and went on to further elaborate it in dozens of essays, books, and public appearances.

In the final years of her life, Rand had this to say,

**" The elaboration of a philosophical system is a job that no philosopher can finish in his lifetime. There is still an awful lot of work to be done."**

The Atlas Society is continuing her work by delivering her joyous vision of the world and life's glorious possibilities to new audiences. It's a vision that resonates anew with each new reader who discovers her novels for the first time, and through them, discovers a new vision for themselves as individuals.

clean_body: Friend, Who is Ayn Rand? Most people know her as the author of The Fountainhead and Atlas Shrugged. But she was so much more than a novelist. She was a revolutionary philosopher who inspired both ardent admirers and fierce detractors. Her book, Atlas Shrugged , is cited as one of the most influential books in the last century. So who is this woman behind all the controversy? The Atlas Society teaches people about Ayn Rand, her life, her groundbreaking philosophy, and why her literature is more relevant today than ever. Friend, if you are curious about the life and philosophy of Ayn Rand, click below to watch this video or keep reading. The Life of Ayn Rand Ayn Rand was born Alyssa Rosenbalm on February 2nd, 1905, in St. Petersburg, Russia. At 12 years old, she and her two little sisters witnessed the first shots of the Russian Revolution from the window of their apartment. What she witnessed later, living under Soviet rule, would have a profound impact on her writing and philosophy. On the eve of her 22nd birthday, she got a passport to Chicago to visit relatives, never to return to Russia again. Ayn Rand got her start as a writer in Hollywood, working on many screenplays and short stories, two of which would become Broadway plays. When one of her plays was made into a movie and the studio turned her hero into a villain, she was inspired to write a novel about a visionary architect who would not compromise his creative vision for the sake of others: The Foundationhead. Much like Ayn Rand, The Atlas Society refused to compromise our vision of bringing her philosophy to new audiences. We have made it our mission to bring Ayn Rand's ideas to life for young people, and we do it by transforming Ayn Rand's work into a variety of vehicles that appeal most to them. Now more than ever before, younger generations need to understand the ideas of individual liberty, free market economics, and sound philosophy. Through our graphic novels, pocket guides, animated videos, digital content, and educational programs and conferences, we are reaching tens of millions of young minds. Ayn Rand wrote her magnum opus, Atlas Shrugged , at a time when America began romanticizing socialism (much as we are seeing again today). The novel was the fullest dramatic encapsulation of her philosophic ideas, that man is a heroic being who should pursue his own happiness, neither sacrificing himself to others nor sacrificing others to himself. She called this philosophy Objectivism and went on to further elaborate it in dozens of essays, books, and public appearances. In the final years of her life, Rand had this to say, " The elaboration of a philosophical system is a job that no philosopher can finish in his lifetime. There is still an awful lot of work to be done." The Atlas Society is continuing her work by delivering her joyous vision of the world and life's glorious possibilities to new audiences. It's a vision that resonates anew with each new reader who discovers her novels for the first time, and through them, discovers a new vision for themselves as individuals. At The Atlas Society, we've set out to engage a BILLION young minds with the ideas of Ayn Rand. You can help by clicking any button below and donating today. With grit, grace, and gratitude, Jennifer Anju Grossman (JAG) CEO, The Atlas Society The Atlas Society is a 501(c)(3) Not For Profit Organization. body:
I’m running to do what’s right.
|

| | | |

Peter – I didn’t plan to go to Washington DC.
However, after devoting my career to serving the people of North Carolina, I couldn’t just stand by and watch the far right rip away health care access, gut resources for public education and chip away at the middle class.
They’re not making this country stronger. Only the opposite.
**That’s why I’m running for Senate – and I need folks like you by my side to win.**
**[The GOP is pouring nearly $100 million _so far_ into defeating me and saving their grip on power – and now, a recent poll has this race statistically tied. Your contribution could make all the difference in an election this close, so can I please count on you to pitch in?](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14264?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk596&amount=5&t=8&akid=1798%2E124072%2EbosmOv)**
I’m a pretty calm guy, Peter. Not much gets me riled up.
But watching Washington DC politicians make dirty deals at the expense of working families struggling to get by? That’s another thing entirely.
We know exactly what my Republican opponent will do if he’s elected to the U.S. Senate: **whatever President Trump tells him to – not what’s best for North Carolinians.**
He’s ready and willing to hurt the American people if it helps further one man’s self-serving agenda. That’s just wrong. I’m running to do what’s right.
**[I can’t compete with MAGA's massive cash advantage on my own, though. Please give whatever fits in your budget now to help defeat my far-right opponent, flip the Senate and finally put a stop to the cruelty and chaos that’s causing so much harm nationwide.](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14264?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk596&amount=5&t=9&akid=1798%2E124072%2EbosmOv)**

name: Kiros for Congress
subject: 3 things you can do this week to elect Melat Kiros
body:
Find your place in our fight, on the doors, on the phones, and more!
| |
---
| Friends, We’re now less than two weeks away from electing a working class champion—an immigrant, a fighter who put her career on the line for the movement for Palestine. Every week, our volunteers and coalition hit the pavement to get out the vote for Melat. This campaign is powered by thousands of Denverites—working people who make our city run—and by neighbors right here in our district who are showing up and chipping in. It’s safe to say—Denver is all in for Melat Kiros. But in these final days, we need to dig a little deeper to lock in this victory. We knew our opposition was heavily funded but we now know it's to the tune of more than $1,000,000 dollars by corporations, real estate developers, executives, and potentially AIPAC-linked groups—**a real nightmare blunt rotation** —and we know that the Democratic establishment won’t sleep in these final weeks. Right now, it’s anyone’s race. To beat organized money, we need organized people. The most important thing you can do right now is simple: knock on a door and talk to your neighbor. We’re canvassing every day across the city—[**find a shift near you.**](https://www.solidarity.tech/ahoy/messages/BaOpCr7ZplOPlJBktKB4J7KQdosIHVSZ/click?signature=6b49fd8a3dca767a4907dd8b354a2b9ff355e157&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwin.kirosforco.com%2Fcanvass) If it’s your first time, we’ll train you and pair you with an experienced volunteer. If you can’t make it out, you can still make an impact. Join us Thursday at 6pm for a volunteer phonebank and[******help turn out more neighbors to the doors.**](https://www.solidarity.tech/ahoy/messages/BaOpCr7ZplOPlJBktKB4J7KQdosIHVSZ/click?signature=25f0ab90851ec98f1af040c669be796a9071ff65&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwin.kirosforco.com%2Fphonebank) We’ll walk you through everything—you’ll be up and running in minutes. And on Juneteenth, we’re coming together to celebrate and organize. Join us Friday for a [**scavenger hunt and bike ride**](https://www.solidarity.tech/ahoy/messages/BaOpCr7ZplOPlJBktKB4J7KQdosIHVSZ/click?signature=5004d0480c7d8726ecb155f343c39dffd44f5343&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwin.kirosforco.com%2Fscavengerhunt) starting at The People’s Center (730 21st Street), highlighting Denver’s deep history of struggle and solidarity. We’ll wrap with live music, food, drinks, prizes, and more. See you out there. In solidarity, Team Kiros for Congress****

body:
The biggest housing bill in 30 years is one signature away

| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=2932%2E4032634%2ESF_kiW)
---
I'm going to say something that might shock you: we're one step closer to passing the most significant housing legislation in 30 years. I have joined forces with Republicans and Democrats in both the House and the Senate to create the 21st Century ROAD to Housing Act, which will build more housing and lower costs for families. This bill includes more than 40 provisions to help boost housing supply, reduce homelessness, cut red tape and streamline construction, expand access to homeownership — **and for the first time ever, stop private equity executives from hoarding homes that should be owned and lived in by families.** Year after year, Congress has stood by, shocked by the rising cost of housing. Now we’re actually doing something about it — and showing that it is possible for our government to actually work for working people. [**I’m going to fight my heart out to help Democrats take back our majorities this November. But even with Republicans controlling Congress, there are still some places where the door is open to making real change — and I’m going to fight to get as much done as possible with the Congress we have now. Will you pitch in $28 or anything you can now to strengthen our fight?**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/3674?amount=28&t=8&akid=2932%2E4032634%2ESF_kiW)

We are in a dire housing crisis across rural communities, small towns, suburban neighborhoods, and major cities. A majority of Americans can’t afford rent on a modest 2-bedroom. Nearly two in three renters don’t believe they could buy a home in the foreseeable future. Americans aren't buying their first home until age 40 — while hearing stories of their grandparents buying their home for a tiny fraction of the cost today. Since 1990, the cost of housing is up 174% while wages have flatlined. This is a simple Economics 101 problem: We’ve got to increase the supply of available housing on the market to bring down costs. We do that in this bill by cutting bureaucratic red tape, expanding access to homeownership, making robust federal investments to build more housing that families want to live in, and preventing private equity executives from hoarding homes as investment opportunities that should be owned and lived in by families. This bill is ready. It's time to send it to the President's desk and deliver real relief for families across the country. [**I’m going to keep doing everything I can to get this bill passed, work with the Congress we have now to get relief to the American people, and take back our majorities in November so we can pass more transformational policies for working people. If you’re able, please pitch in $28 or whatever makes sense to support our work and continue making progress for working people.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/3674?amount=28&t=14&akid=2932%2E4032634%2ESF_kiW) Thanks for being a part of this, Elizabeth
